summary: Budget volume ring (his second, cheap craft): bought magic ring with a T1 elemental attack flat, Greater Essence of Opulence for T1 rarity, a cold-catalysed Greater Exaltation slam for a second flat, collarbone only on hits.

steps: Buy magic rings with a T1 fire or lightning attack flat, 25-30 ex each (9:02-9:07); base name not stated, Gold Ring assumed
Greater Essence of Opulence for T1 rarity (15-18%, the Greater tier)
Cold (Tul's) catalyst quality, Omen of Catalysing Exaltation + Omen of Greater Exaltation + Greater Exalted Orb: hoping for a cold flat, % cold, cold or all res
Only on rings that hit: Preserved Collarbone, reveal with Abyssal Echoes for a flat, rarity or life
Per success = 2 rings (four rings, about two hits, 14:26-14:44); materials are per success but baseDiv is ONE base, so the creator side holds one base fewer than he bought
Base in Divine is derived: 25-30 ex at an unstated rate (100-300 ex/div assumed); the video's own prices don't fix a rate

Stated: 'around three div per ring, so 12 div investment' (15:35-15:42), ~6 div per finished hit. Catalyst counts assume ~1% quality per catalyst (creator footage: Diztoh GDLDxn6yxEs 4:24-4:47, OperatorOtter NUiXXbrPS4E 8:36); the KB community formula says ~2% at ilvl 72-84, which would halve them (unresolved).
